As a production employee in this two-shift work schedule, you are goint to work in a dynamic environment where quality and precision are paramount. You will work from Monday to Friday in varying shifts from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM and from 3:00 PM to midnight. Because of these shifts, you are entitled to a shift allowance starting from 6:00 PM, and you also receive a dressing allowance of 3.35 Euros per day. Due to the allowance, your hourly wage from 6:00 PM will be 18.75 Euros. You have a 40-minute break of which you get 10 minutes from the boss, so you can change clothes at a relaxed pace. This position offers excellent opportunities for advancement and opportiunities to further develop your skills; for example, you could grow into an operator position in the future.

You start your workday with a short team meeting where the goals for the day are discussed. After that, you begin your tasks, such as operating production machines, checking the quality of the products, process the necessary documentation, manual production work, and packaging products. Hygiene and safety are crucial, so you work according to strict protocols in the cleanroom. Collaborating with your team is essential to ensure the production runs smoothly. Do you have a friend/partner you like to work with? That’s possible! Apply together for this job posting and who knows, you might be working together in the cleanroom soon.

- Familiarity with hygiene protocols

Do you carry trays full of wine more balanced than a gymnastic on the balance beam? We're on the lookout for hospitable servers for our in-house restaurant The Lobby. Apply now!

As a Food & Beverage Service Employee, you are at the very heart of our restaurant. You work across breakfast, lunch, and dinner service, serving dishes, creating a warm atmosphere, and ensuring guests have an unforgettable experience — often before they even ask. No two days are the same, as you effortlessly switch between different moments of the day in a dynamic and lively environment.

You're an all-rounder: you take reservations, welcome and seat guests, take orders, serve dishes, and handle payments smoothly. You work according to established procedures, while keeping your approach personal and genuinely hospitable. At the same time, you make sure every table experience is spot on — from start to finish. You introduce guests to high-quality products and fine wines, and have a natural feel for what each guest needs. That's what makes the difference between simply dining out and an experience to remember.

Our menu continuously surprises with seasonal, honest dishes — from generous pancakes to refined eggs Benedict and classic salads. You present and serve these dishes in a warm and professional way, ensuring every guest enjoys a complete experience.

Our restaurant on Fizeaustraat is located in a vibrant neighborhood in Amsterdam East, where both locals and tourists love to come together. Away from the hustle and bustle, yet still easily accessible. Whether guests stop by for breakfast, drinks, or a relaxing moment by the fireplace, you make sure they feel welcome and at home right away.
